facts.text: Grimny's ghost believes his brother Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarf brothers, killed him. Did Bral really murder Grimny, and how?
Where is Bral now? He is the dwarf who lost the party their map in a gambling bet.
Dunk wears the magic ring taken from the dead dwarf at the mine. It let its wearer see and speak with Grimny's ghost, but it may no longer do anything now that Grimny has ascended.
facts.uncertain_reason: Grimny's ghost departed (beat_81); unclear whether the ring still has any use.

facts.text: Is the magic ring Dunk is wearing cursed? Dr. Uriah's witch powder showed it is magical but could not tell, and Dunk put it on after feeling a growing urge to.
